description: This Java source file defines the QuoteServices class with static methods for handling quote-related operations such as sending quote report emails and storing quotes within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: QuoteServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing quotes, including email notifications and quote creation within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: sendQuoteReportMail
methods.description: Sends an email report for a quote, retrieving email settings and quote details, and dispatching the email via the sendMailFromScreen service.

methods.name: storeQuote
methods.description: Creates and stores a new quote along with associated items, attributes, coefficients, roles, work efforts, and adjustments, using various create services.
